name: Obsidian
author: Hermes
description: Stacked phrase-alignment waveforms, engraved mixer controls, vinyl landmarks and a full collection below.
tradeoff: Strongest all-round starting point; familiar without copying a product.

name: Signal
author: Hermes
description: A technical, waveform-first workspace. Large aligned transients replace platter graphics, leaving more space for the library.
tradeoff: Best for beatmatching and dense sets; deliberately less tactile.

name: Alloy
author: Hermes
description: Warm mineral surfaces, olive controls and clean type. A daylight alternative to the usual black booth.
tradeoff: Clear preparation and long-session legibility; intentionally not a nightclub palette.

name: Nocturne
author: Hermes
description: Oversized platters frame a vertical phrase display. Quiet violet and rose identify the decks without lighting the entire screen.
tradeoff: Most expressive booth identity; vertical alignment replaces the usual horizontal overview.

name: Studio
author: Hermes
thesis: Your collection and four decks, together.
description: A persistent library occupies the left third while a compact four-deck workspace and effects live on the right.
tradeoff: Best for preparation during layered sets; higher information density.
